key_insight: FaultScope estimates logical error rates and attributes their sensitivity to individual noisy components using the same sampled and decoded shots.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can identify noise hotspots and prioritize component improvements when optimizing fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures.
method: Rust simulator with a Python interface for quantum error correction circuits.
Supports forward error propagation and direct sampling from detector error models.
Estimates derivatives with respect to component error rates without modifying or differentiating through the decoder.
evidence_signal: FaultScope had the lowest runtime among tested simulators at every benchmarked size; computing all derivatives added 0.33–0.97% overhead across five repetition-code sizes with 7–2047 error locations.
watch_item: The reported derivative overhead is demonstrated on repetition codes; performance on other code families and noise models needs validation.
paper_title: FaultScope: A software package for fast error attribution in quantum error correction
